review: The hymn is the surrendered plan: the chorus is Jer 29:11 (מַחְשְׁבוֹת שָׁלוֹם) with Prov 16:9 and Eph 2:10; 1:1–8 is Ps 37:23 with Ps 32:8 and Isa 30:21, and 2:1–8 is Ps 131:2 with Jas 1:5 and Prov 3:5–6.
The chorus stands first as the print's [القرار] before the numbered stanzas; the payload keeps it labelled, so the hymn opens with the assurance and then prays it out.

2:2 וְאֶזָּרֵק בְּחֵיקְךָ וְאֶמַּס — the Arabic واترمي في حِضنك وادُوب is 'cast into Your bosom and melt'; the Hebrew keeps both verbs with זָרַק and מָסַס, so the surrender is physical and unguarded rather than a sentiment.
